name: Miniflux
description: Minimalist, keyboard-driven feed reader that stays out of your way (compose stack with Postgres).

ru.description: Минималистичная читалка лент с управлением с клавиатуры (compose-стек с Postgres).

composeYaml:
services:
  db:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: miniflux
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      POSTGRES_DB: miniflux
    volumes:
      - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "pg_isready", "-U", "miniflux"]
      interval: 10s
      retries: 10
  miniflux:
    image: miniflux/miniflux:latest
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_healthy
    ports:
      - "8080:8080"
    environment:
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://miniflux:${DB_PASSWORD}@db/miniflux?sslmode=disable
      RUN_MIGRATIONS: "1"
      CREATE_ADMIN: "1"
      ADMIN_USERNAME: ${ADMIN_USERNAME:-admin}
      ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
volumes:
  pgdata:
